report_text:
POSTMORTEM EXAMINATION REPORT

Subject: Kavya Reddy | Age: 57
Body Temperature at Scene: 25.5°C | Ambient Temperature: 31.1°C
Postmortem Interval (estimated): 11.4 hours

INJURIES IDENTIFIED:
  1. Upper Limb: Defensive bruising on forearms [MODERATE]
  2. Abdominal: Blunt force trauma with splenic laceration [MODERATE]
  3. Neck: Compression marks consistent with ligature strangulation [SEVERE]

TOXICOLOGY (Preliminary): None detected

RIGOR MORTIS: Full rigor present in all muscle groups.
LIVOR MORTIS: Fixed posterior — no repositioning detected.

FORENSIC NOTES:
The pattern of injuries and postmortem indicators are consistent with a spontaneous violent altercation. Toxicological findings show no intoxicating substances.
